Structured Pre-Fit Assumption Register

Source: R/profile_check_assumptions.R
profile_check_assumptions.Rd

Assembles the fixed 12-question assumption register this family's design review requires (Section C of the implementation spec), auto-filling whatever rows are genuinely computable from diagnostics ALREADY produced elsewhere in this package – never re-deriving them – and leaving every other row status = "not_evaluated". A statistically untestable assumption (e.g. whether testing is informatively selective on the unobserved resistance value, or whether shared interactions are scientifically plausible) is never marked "verified_by_data_contract" by this function, no matter what inputs are supplied – only correct_unit, design_estimable, and direct_support_present/priors_appropriate have any automatic path to that status, and only when the relevant hard check actually passed.

Usage

profile_check_assumptions(
  support = NULL,
  fixed_effect_design = NULL,
  prior_predictive = NULL,
  reviewer_notes = list()
)

Arguments

support

Output of profile_audit_support, or NULL to leave direct_support_present unfilled.

fixed_effect_design

Output of profile_build_fixed_effect_design, or NULL to leave design_estimable unfilled.

prior_predictive

Output of profile_prior_predictive, or NULL to leave priors_appropriate unfilled.

reviewer_notes

Named list, keyed by assumption_id (an error names the offending key if any is unrecognized – this catches a typo rather than silently dropping the note). Each element is a list with any of note (free text), status (one of "verified_by_data_contract", "diagnosed", "assumed", "not_evaluated", "violated"), sensitivity_plan. Applied AFTER the automatic fills, so a reviewer can override an automatic verdict with their own judgment (e.g. downgrading "verified_by_data_contract" to "assumed" if they have reservations the automatic check cannot see).

Value

A data frame, one row per assumption_id: claim, evidence, diagnostic, limitation, sensitivity_plan, severity ("not_assessed", "low", "moderate", "blocking"), status, reviewer_note.

Details

Rows this function CAN auto-fill, and from what:

correct_unit

from support – profile_audit_support's $class$n_duplicates_collapsed (identical duplicates collapsed, never inflating a count). Reported as "diagnosed", not "verified_by_data_contract" – profile_audit_support()'s default conflict_action = "error" means a CONFLICTING duplicate would already have stopped whatever call produced support (so its mere existence is good evidence), but this function cannot see which conflict_action that call actually used, so it stops short of "verified".

design_estimable

from fixed_effect_design – profile_build_fixed_effect_design's return value; checks rank == ncol(X).

direct_support_present

from support – profile_audit_support's return value; flags any zero-count group x class cell. Always status = "diagnosed", never "verified" – a nonzero count is not identifiability or adequate precision (see profile_plan_precision).

priors_appropriate

from prior_predictive – profile_prior_predictive's return value; flags extreme (near-0 or near-max) entropy ratios. Always status = "diagnosed" – flags only extreme concentration, a reviewer still has to judge clinical plausibility of the actual implied margins/pair probabilities.

Every other row requires an explicit human judgment, supplied via reviewer_notes.
